description.value: Subway Westshore Town Centre is a franchise sandwich shop located in Westshore Town Centre mall in the Langford/Victoria area, serving Footlongs, 6" subs, wraps, and salads. It offers in-restaurant dining, curbside pickup, and delivery, with breakfast service available. As a mall-anchored location, it provides a convenient stop for cyclists navigating the Westshore corridor.
